raw: Reed tries her best to look straight into Wellington's eyes.
content: Reed tries her best to look straight into Wellington's eyes.

raw: She knows well what holds the most power on the battlefield. She knows she is qualified to wield it—and that that right is all she has.
content: She knows well what holds the most power on the battlefield. She knows she is qualified to wield it—and that that right is all she has.

raw: She also knows that once she uses it, there will be no turning back.
content: She also knows that once she uses it, there will be no turning back.

raw: But she was never uninvolved, and that is precisely why she came here.
content: But she was never uninvolved, and that is precisely why she came here.

speaker: Reed
content: (Takes a deep breath)

raw: [name="Reed"]Then, Your Grace, I... I order... you.
speaker: Reed
content: Then, Your Grace, I... I order... you.

speaker: Reed
content: In the name of Tara.

raw: [name="Reed"]I order you to rescue the Victorian civilians inside the city.
speaker: Reed
content: I order you to rescue the Victorian civilians inside the city.

raw: [name="Reed"]I order your fleet to smash the weak Sarkaz defense line, to bring Londinium the relief she should have had long ago.
speaker: Reed
content: I order your fleet to smash the weak Sarkaz defense line, to bring Londinium the relief she should have had long ago.

raw: [name="Reed"]I order the Taran army to demonstrate noblesse oblige, not for material benefit, but for all to see our glory.
speaker: Reed
content: I order the Taran army to demonstrate noblesse oblige, not for material benefit, but for all to see our glory.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: As you command.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Any other orders?

raw: [name="Reed"]You've been stationed outside Londinium this whole time, yet you acquiesced to my command so easily... Could it be because my sister...?
speaker: Reed
content: You've been stationed outside Londinium this whole time, yet you acquiesced to my command so easily... Could it be because my sister...?

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: No.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]My presence here means only one thing: that once again, I was able to witness the cowardice and evil of the Victorians.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: My presence here means only one thing: that once again, I was able to witness the cowardice and evil of the Victorians.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]As long as you are willing to give orders, you will have command.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: As long as you are willing to give orders, you will have command.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]You merely made a choice. To align yourself with Her Highness Eblana, and the newborn Tara.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: You merely made a choice. To align yourself with Her Highness Eblana, and the newborn Tara.

speaker: Reed
content: ...I did.

raw: [name="Reed"]I would have come here even if the city was not being besieged.
speaker: Reed
content: I would have come here even if the city was not being besieged.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]If so, then I believe Her Highness will soon find the time to grant you an audience. I'm sorry to say, but this truly is an inconvenient time for her to meet you.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: If so, then I believe Her Highness will soon find the time to grant you an audience. I'm sorry to say, but this truly is an inconvenient time for her to meet you.

speaker: Reed
content: What is she planning?

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Does it matter? Whether it succeeds or fails, it will nonetheless benefit Tara.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Does it matter? Whether it succeeds or fails, it will nonetheless benefit Tara.

speaker: Reed
content: ...Truly?

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]She made a promise. And she will honor it.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: She made a promise. And she will honor it.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Do excuse me.

raw: The command center returns to silence as Reed scrutinizes the conversation they just had.
content: The command center returns to silence as Reed scrutinizes the conversation they just had.

raw: She completed some of her objectives and learned a few things, but is left even more puzzled.
content: She completed some of her objectives and learned a few things, but is left even more puzzled.

raw: She has stepped in, and can no longer turn back.
content: She has stepped in, and can no longer turn back.

speaker: Flag Officer
content: Miss Loughshinny.

speaker: Reed
content: You are...?

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]The general ordered me to escort you out and show you to your cabin.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: The general ordered me to escort you out and show you to your cabin.

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]You may spend your time aboard the Gastrell as you please before we reach Taran territory.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: You may spend your time aboard the Gastrell as you please before we reach Taran territory.

raw: [name="Reed"]My apologies, but there are people waiting for me.
speaker: Reed
content: My apologies, but there are people waiting for me.

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]Do you mean the Tarans who have been following you?
speaker: Flag Officer
content: Do you mean the Tarans who have been following you?

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]The general did consider this. He is willing to send a squad to lead them to our camp here, and let them board a ride on a support ship back to the capital, Na Saoirsí.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: The general did consider this. He is willing to send a squad to lead them to our camp here, and let them board a ride on a support ship back to the capital, Na Saoirsí.

raw: [name="Reed"]No, I promised them I would return.
speaker: Reed
content: No, I promised them I would return.

raw: [name="Reed"]Just as I am promising you right now, and have promised His Grace, that I will return to Na Saoirsí.
speaker: Reed
content: Just as I am promising you right now, and have promised His Grace, that I will return to Na Saoirsí.

raw: [name="Reed"]I believe we made that clear in our earlier exchange.
speaker: Reed
content: I believe we made that clear in our earlier exchange.

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]My apologies, but I'll need to ask the general about this...
speaker: Flag Officer
content: My apologies, but I'll need to ask the general about this...

speaker: Flag Officer
content: He's busy? Ugh... But...

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]What?! With your busy schedule, even...
speaker: Flag Officer
content: What?! With your busy schedule, even...

speaker: Flag Officer
content: Y—Yes! As you command!

speaker: Flag Officer
content: Miss Loughshinny.

speaker: Reed
content: I'm listening.

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]Direct orders from The Leader. She has instructed us not to interfere with your movements.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: Direct orders from The Leader. She has instructed us not to interfere with your movements.

speaker: Reed
content: 'The Leader'?

speaker: Flag Officer
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Flag Officer"]But she does ardently hope that you can stay just a little while longer.
speaker: Flag Officer
content: But she does ardently hope that you can stay just a little while longer.

speaker: Flag Officer
content: To witness a grand performance.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Are you sure about not meeting her personally?
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Are you sure about not meeting her personally?

speaker: Eblana
content: No need to.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Strictly speaking, the war has yet to end. Nothing good will come of meeting Loughshinny now. It would only bring her more confusion.
speaker: Eblana
content: Strictly speaking, the war has yet to end. Nothing good will come of meeting Loughshinny now. It would only bring her more confusion.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Very well, Your Highness. Please return to the command center and await the good news.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Very well, Your Highness. Please return to the command center and await the good news.

speaker: Eblana
content: Hold on.

speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: What do you mean?

raw: [name="Eblana"]Seeing that Loughshinny is willing to tie her own fate to Tara's, we should show her the might of the nation she is about to be a part of.
speaker: Eblana
content: Seeing that Loughshinny is willing to tie her own fate to Tara's, we should show her the might of the nation she is about to be a part of.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]Rest assured. We would demonstrate it with the Sarkaz's prompt defeat.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: Rest assured. We would demonstrate it with the Sarkaz's prompt defeat.

raw: [name="Duke of Wellington"]But if you prefer a more personal show of force, the Gastrell is more than willing to oblige.
speaker: Duke of Wellington
content: But if you prefer a more personal show of force, the Gastrell is more than willing to oblige.

speaker: Eblana
content: Consider it a grand welcome.

raw: [name="Eblana"]As my dear sister has made her wishes clear, shouldn't I help her realize them with my own hands?
speaker: Eblana
content: As my dear sister has made her wishes clear, shouldn't I help her realize them with my own hands?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout Captain"]Didn't I tell you it doesn't matter where that Vouivre came from? She's helping the Victorians, so she's got to die. Simple as that.
speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: Didn't I tell you it doesn't matter where that Vouivre came from? She's helping the Victorians, so she's got to die. Simple as that.

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout"]We're... We're no match for her.
speaker: Sarkaz Scout
content: We're... We're no match for her.

speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: You're worthless!

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout Captain"]...Bah, forget it. It's just one Vouivre—
speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: ...Bah, forget it. It's just one Vouivre—

speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: What was that noise?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout"]A—A high-speed battleship! Currently speeding towards the city walls!
speaker: Sarkaz Scout
content: A—A high-speed battleship! Currently speeding towards the city walls!

speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: Victorian?

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout"]It's the Gastrell—it's that Duke of Wellington guy!
speaker: Sarkaz Scout
content: It's the Gastrell—it's that Duke of Wellington guy!

raw: [name="Sarkaz Scout"]Not just him, Caster's fleet seems to be spontaneously coordinating with his ships!
speaker: Sarkaz Scout
content: Not just him, Caster's fleet seems to be spontaneously coordinating with his ships!

speaker: Sarkaz Scout Captain
content: Raid! Raid incoming—

speaker: Sarkaz Scout
content: Purple flames?! Captain—

raw: [Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[ImageTween(xFrom=100, yFrom=-70, xTo=0, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=25, block=false)]
Atop the Gastrell's bow stands The Leader of Dublinn, purple flames spreading from the tip of her spear to the city walls.
content: Atop the Gastrell's bow stands The Leader of Dublinn, purple flames spreading from the tip of her spear to the city walls.

raw: Her flames of death erupt from the Sarkaz on the perimeter, spreading to adjacent victims as they wantonly seek the next host, leaving only the floating Nachzehrer untouched by fire.
content: Her flames of death erupt from the Sarkaz on the perimeter, spreading to adjacent victims as they wantonly seek the next host, leaving only the floating Nachzehrer untouched by fire.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Nachzehrer. 'God of War'? 'Lord of War and Death'?
speaker: Eblana
content: Nachzehrer. 'God of War'? 'Lord of War and Death'?

raw: [name="Eblana"]A shame there is no longer enough death here to sate you.
speaker: Eblana
content: A shame there is no longer enough death here to sate you.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Even living legends have their endings. But surely becoming the kindling of a new legend is better than wasting away in obscurity?
speaker: Eblana
content: Even living legends have their endings. But surely becoming the kindling of a new legend is better than wasting away in obscurity?

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Oh. The brazenly ambitious young Draco.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Very well then.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Red Dragon who toys with life and death on a spear. Just how well do you comprehend death?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Red Dragon who toys with life and death on a spear. Just how well do you comprehend death?

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]I suppose this is not the worst way to kill time before the war is over.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I suppose this is not the worst way to kill time before the war is over.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Do try to hold on a little longer, Nachzehrer.
speaker: Eblana
content: Do try to hold on a little longer, Nachzehrer.

raw: [name="Eblana"]Let us show those Victorians what death truly is, while the artillery still rings.
speaker: Eblana
content: Let us show those Victorians what death truly is, while the artillery still rings.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]I have waited a long time, young Draco.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I have waited a long time, young Draco.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You are bolder than the others.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Then use those flames of yours to send a message to those cowards surrounding the city—
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Then use those flames of yours to send a message to those cowards surrounding the city—

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I am here.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: The war is here.

raw: The stench of rot thickens as the ice-cold flames of death rage.
content: The stench of rot thickens as the ice-cold flames of death rage.

raw: Death crashes into death, over the faint shelling and thin city walls.
content: Death crashes into death, over the faint shelling and thin city walls.

speaker: Landless Farmer
content: Th—They really started fighting?

speaker: Refugee Artisan
content: Did The Leader...

raw: [name="Wounded Abandoned Soldier"]Shush! There's no way she'd...
speaker: Wounded Abandoned Soldier
content: Shush! There's no way she'd...

raw: [name="Wounded Abandoned Soldier"]No. We have to go find her.
speaker: Wounded Abandoned Soldier
content: No. We have to go find her.

raw: [name="Moran"]We promised we'd wait for her here.
speaker: Moran
content: We promised we'd wait for her here.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Wounded Abandoned Soldier"]But the fighting's broken out in Londinium again!
speaker: Wounded Abandoned Soldier
content: But the fighting's broken out in Londinium again!

speaker: Moran
content: ...Just believe in her—

raw: [name="Wounded Abandoned Soldier"]I do, but listen! That's the sound of witchcraft, and the Dukes' cannons! How could The Leader—
speaker: Wounded Abandoned Soldier
content: I do, but listen! That's the sound of witchcraft, and the Dukes' cannons! How could The Leader—

speaker: Moran
content: —Like she believes in us.

raw: The wounded soldier is left speechless, only able to look back on the tranquility now torn apart by flame and chaos. Searching for a reason for his squad to join the battlefield.
content: The wounded soldier is left speechless, only able to look back on the tranquility now torn apart by flame and chaos. Searching for a reason for his squad to join the battlefield.

raw: Past the smoke and mire he sees a figure.
content: Past the smoke and mire he sees a figure.
The Leader. Reed. Loughshinny.

raw: She finished her own fight, held true to her promise, and returns to lead them on, to the end of their journey...
content: She finished her own fight, held true to her promise, and returns to lead them on, to the end of their journey...
To home, to peace.

speaker: Reed
content: Let's go, everyone.

raw: [name="Reed"]What is happening there is no longer something we can involve ourselves in.
speaker: Reed
content: What is happening there is no longer something we can involve ourselves in.

speaker: Reed
content: It's time to head home.
